name: Mutt
flavor: Nobody knows the recipe. Everybody loves the result.

name: Labrador Retriever
flavor: Will retrieve anything, including things you did not throw.

name: Golden Retriever
flavor: A walking sunbeam that sheds.

name: Beagle
flavor: Follows its nose straight into the neighbour's yard.

name: Pug
flavor: Snores louder than the lawnmower.

name: Dachshund
flavor: Half a dog high, two dogs long.

name: Chihuahua
flavor: Tiny body, enormous opinions.

name: Poodle
flavor: Smarter than you. Knows it. Is polite about it.

name: Bulldog
flavor: Built like a footstool, sits like one too.

name: Boxer
flavor: Greets you by bouncing exactly at face height.

name: Pembroke Welsh Corgi
flavor: Short legs, long ambitions, perfect loaf.

name: German Shepherd
flavor: Takes fetch extremely seriously.

name: Shih Tzu
flavor: Has a hairdo and a schedule.

name: Pomeranian
flavor: A dandelion puff with a bark.

name: Yorkshire Terrier
flavor: Ribbon optional. Attitude included.

name: Jack Russell Terrier
flavor: Runs on springs and pure espresso.

name: French Bulldog
flavor: Bat ears tuned to the sound of snacks.

name: Rottweiler
flavor: A big softie in a security uniform.

name: Doberman
flavor: Sleek, sharp, and secretly scared of the vacuum.

name: Great Dane
flavor: Thinks it is a lap dog. It is not.

name: Cocker Spaniel
flavor: Ears like curtains, heart like a pillow.

name: Maltese
flavor: A cloud that learned to trot.

name: Bichon Frise
flavor: Bounces like a dropped marshmallow.

name: Basset Hound
flavor: Ears touch the ground. Nose does too.

name: Boston Terrier
flavor: Always dressed for a party.

name: Miniature Schnauzer
flavor: Sports a moustache it is very proud of.

name: Cavalier King Charles Spaniel
flavor: Royal manners, couch potato ambitions.

name: Labradoodle
flavor: Curly, cheerful and permanently damp.

name: Goldendoodle
flavor: A teddy bear that fetches.

name: Cockapoo
flavor: Bouncy curls and bottomless enthusiasm.

name: Puggle
flavor: Pug face, beagle nose, zero chill.

name: Border Terrier
flavor: Otter-faced and fence-proof. Mostly.

name: West Highland White Terrier
flavor: Bright white for exactly four minutes after a bath.

name: Lemon Beagle
flavor: The palest beagle on the block.

name: Chocolate Lab
flavor: Rich, sweet and very bad for your shoes.

name: Black Lab
flavor: Disappears at night except for the tail wag.

name: Fox Red Lab
flavor: A ginger lab with a fox's grin.

name: Patchwork Mutt
flavor: Stitched together from the best bits of six breeds.

name: Scruffy Mutt
flavor: Looks like it just crawled out of the hedge. It did.

name: Brindle Boxer
flavor: Tiger stripes, puppy brain.

name: Black Pug
flavor: A small cannonball of snorts.

name: Dapple Dachshund
flavor: Spotted sausage, extra relish.

name: Wirehaired Dachshund
flavor: A sausage with eyebrows.

name: Longhaired Chihuahua
flavor: Fluffy ears, fierce soul.

name: Parti Poodle
flavor: A poodle with a paint splash.

name: Miniature Poodle
flavor: Fits in a tote bag. Refuses to.

name: Muddy Mutt
flavor: Has never once arrived home clean.

name: Shepherd Mix
flavor: Part guard dog, part goofball.

name: Morkie
flavor: Maltese fluff meets Yorkie sass.

name: Tricolor Corgi
flavor: Three colours, two short legs, one big smile.

name: Sable Corgi
flavor: Dusted with charcoal like a burnt marshmallow.

name: Dorgi
flavor: Corgi meets dachshund. Low rider.

name: Shichon
flavor: Teddy bear cut, every day.

name: Harlequin Dane
flavor: A giant inkblot test that loves you.

name: Sprinkler Spaniel
flavor: Chases every arc of the sprinkler, forever.

name: Flowerbed Frenchie
flavor: Digs up the tulips, then poses in them.

name: Hammock Hound
flavor: Professional napper. Amateur fetcher.

name: Picket Pomeranian
flavor: Guards the fence from every leaf that blows by.

name: Barbecue Beagle
flavor: Appears the second the grill lid opens.

name: Mud Puddle Pug
flavor: Finds the one puddle in a dry summer.

name: Doghouse Dachshund
flavor: Renovated the doghouse. Mostly with teeth.

name: Bird Bath Bichon
flavor: Sits in the bird bath. The birds are upset.

name: Tomato Patch Terrier
flavor: Stole every tomato. Green ones too.

name: Tire Swing Shepherd
flavor: Pushes the kids on the swing. With its face.

name: Lemonade Lab
flavor: Runs the lemonade stand. Drinks the profits.

name: Patio Poodle
flavor: Lounges on the patio like it owns the house.

name: Firefly Corgi
flavor: Chases fireflies until the porch light comes on.

name: Sunhat Schnauzer
flavor: Inspects the vegetable garden every morning.

name: Bandana Boxer
flavor: Wears a bandana for every occasion.

name: Jingle Beagle
flavor: You always know where it is. Always.

name: Grill Chef Corgi
flavor: Supervises the sausages very closely.

name: Tool Belt Terrier
flavor: Fixed the fence. Dug under it. Fixed it again.

name: Bow Tie Bulldog
flavor: Dressed for a garden party nobody planned.

name: Slugger Lab
flavor: Catches pop flies. Keeps the ball.

name: Sir Spadeworth
flavor: Knight of the vegetable patch, sworn enemy of moles.

name: Queen Clover
flavor: Rules the lawn from the softest patch of clover.

name: Admiral Hosepipe
flavor: Commands the garden hose like a flagship.

name: Thornbloom
flavor: Roses bloom in its coat and wilt when it leaves.

name: Sundial
flavor: Lies in the same sunbeam all day and somehow it follows.

name: Hedge Hydra
flavor: Two heads, one hedge, zero intruders. Grown, not born.
